CustomField.description: This field indicates whether Amount field is calculated using dependent fields(workflow) or manually user inputs. Its used by Loyalty Commercial managers
CustomField.formula: IF(Amount = Customer_Base__c * Assumed_Tag_Rate_at_Maturity__c * Price_Per_Point__c * Points_Per__c * Average_Spend_Per_Customer__c* Probability , TRUE, FALSE)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If checked, the amount field is calculated by Salesforce
CustomField.label: Is Amount Calculated
